run_linear_evaluation: run linear evaluation on self-supervised encoder checkpoints across CIFAR10, CIFAR100, or STL10 datasets
create_logistic_regression: create a logistic regression PyTorch module with configurable input and output dimensions
extract_encoder_features: extract feature vectors from a pre-trained encoder model using a data loader
